text:
anya: quick question — i'm investigating latency spikes on /v1/generate this morning. where's the canonical grafana dashboard for p50/p95/p99 + TTFT + tokens/sec? need links + any promql snippets i can paste into a ticket :eyes:

chris: use the runtime-latency dashboard (shows percentiles + setup by route). link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/rt123/runtime-latency?orgId=1&var-route=%2Fv1%2Fgenerate

chris: example PromQLs you can paste:
- p95: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le))
- p50: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le))
- p99: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le))

souvik: TTFT is exposed as a histogram metric llm_ttft_seconds. try:
- TTFT p95: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(llm_ttft_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le))
- tokens/sec (per-model): rate(inference_tokens_emitted_total[1m]) by (model)

anya: perfect — can you also point to traces? want to correlate a ~300ms spike at 09:12 UTC with a slow backend call

chris: traces: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/search?service=runtime — filter tag=route:/v1/generate and look for traces around 1765120320. set min-duration=200ms to ignore tiny ones.

chris: quick tip — if TTFT jumps but request_duration not, check prefix cache hit: metric cache_prefix_hit_ratio{model=~".*"}

karen: @anya if this looks like sustained p95 > 1.5s we should page. current alert thresholds are conservative; happy to adjust.

anya: somewhat intermittent — two spikes in 20m. opening a ticket with links and a couple sample traces. can we get an alert tweak suggestion so SRE doesn't get paged for noisy blips?

chris: suggest Alertmanager rule (start conservative):
```
- alert: HighP95LatencyGenerate
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le)) > 1.5
  for: 15m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "p95 latency for /v1/generate > 1.5s"
```
We can change to 10m/1m for more sensitivity once root cause known.

souvik: also add a secondary alert on TTFT p95 > 0.5s for 10m (severity: ticket) — TTFT often moves earlier than full request duration.

anya: adding both to ticket. also including a kibana logs query to pull request IDs: index: logs-inference-* query: route:\"/v1/generate\" AND duration:[200 TO *] AND env:prod. example: https://logs.redwood.ai/app/discover#/?q=route:%22/v1/generate%22%20AND%20duration:%5B200%20TO%20*%5D

deploy-bot: deployment roll 2026-03-07-09:05 completed for service=runtime (git=main@d3f4a7). no errors :white_check_mark:

anya: thanks — i'm attaching sample trace IDs in the ticket. cc @karen @chris for alert follow-up. :thumbsup:

observability-bot: FYI: added dashboard panel template and exported the PromQL snippets to /observability/templates/latency-panel.

karen: quick follow-up — anyone have a short runbook snippet for investigating token throughput drops? we should attach to the ticket.

chris: runbook lines: check model queue length (gauge: inference_queue_length), check tokens/sec per-worker (rate(inference_tokens_emitted_total[1m]) by (worker)), check KV cache hit, then search traces for slow external calls (db/callouts). paste into ticket: "1) grafana p95 + TTFT 2) trace any large backend spans 3) kibana -> get request ids 4) correlate with deploys"

anya: great. ticket created: https://tickets.redwood.ai/RW-4521 — contains grafana links, PromQL, traces, alerts suggestion, and sample logs. i'll keep updates there. thanks all.
